'''Ot'ona''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who held the rank of [[Private/Legends|private]] within the [[Republic Army]], serving on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She distributed [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to other Republic forces at [[Farnel Outpost]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ot&#39;ona appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as an Armor Vendor for Republic players on Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Ot&#39;ona was removed from the game along with the rest of the Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
